/// Three Pillars VoIP — Android AAR
///
/// This directory contains the Android AAR build scaffolding for the
/// Three Pillars VoIP library. The AAR wraps the Rust native library
/// built from `crates/voip-ffi` with Kotlin bindings generated by UniFFI.
///
/// # Build Instructions
///
/// 1. Install Android NDK and set `ANDROID_NDK_HOME`
/// 2. Add Rust Android targets:
///    ```sh
///    rustup target add aarch64-linux-android armv7-linux-androideabi x86_64-linux-android
///    cargo install cargo-ndk
///    ```
/// 3. Build the native library:
///    ```sh
///    cd /path/to/three-pillars-voip
///    cargo ndk -t arm64-v8a -t armeabi-v7a -t x86_64 \
///      -o mobile/android/src/main/jniLibs \
///      build --release -p voip-ffi
///    ```
/// 4. Generate Kotlin bindings:
///    ```sh
///    cargo run --bin uniffi-bindgen generate \
///      --library src/main/jniLibs/arm64-v8a/libvoip_ffi.so \
///      --language kotlin \
///      --out-dir src/main/java
///    ```
/// 5. Build the AAR:
///    ```sh
///    cd mobile/android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
///    ```
///
/// # Usage in Android App
///
/// Add the AAR as a dependency and initialize:
/// ```kotlin
/// val config = VoipConfig(
///     discovery_privacy_first = true,
///     dht_lookup_timeout_ms = 200,
///     dht_bootstrap_nodes = listOf("/ip4/.../p2p/Qm..."),
///     signaling_server_url = "wss://signal.example.com/v1/ws",
///     masque_fallback_enabled = true,
///     push_retry_enabled = true,
///     quic_connect_timeout_ms = 5000,
///     call_ring_timeout_ms = 30000,
/// )
/// val client = VoipClient(config)
/// client.init()
/// client.call("peer-abc123")
/// ```
